preConditions.onFailMessage: form_config cannot be migrated to configured_table: some rows have no type field code, a type is configured twice in the same project, or a duplicated institution numbering config has field settings. Run the check query of changelog 2026-11-02-1 to list them and fix them by hand before restarting.
preConditions.sqlCheck: WITH coded AS ( SELECT fc.config_id, fc.fk_action_unit_id, fc.fk_institution_id, fc.fk_value_concept_id, min(cfc.field_code) AS field_code, count(DISTINCT cfc.field_code) AS codes FROM public.form_config fc LEFT JOIN public.concept_field_config cfc ON cfc.fk_concept_id = fc.fk_field_concept_id AND cfc.field_code IN ('SIARU.TYPE', 'SIAS.CAT', 'SIAPHASE.TYPE', 'SIAC.TYPE', 'SIAD.TYPE', 'SIAST.TYPE', 'SIAAU.TYPE') GROUP BY fc.config_id ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM coded WHERE codes <> 1) + (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM coded WHERE fk_action_unit_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fk_action_unit_id, field_code, fk_value_concept_id HAVING count(*) > 1) project_duplicates) + (SELECT count(*) FROM coded c WHERE c.fk_action_unit_id IS NULL AND c.fk_value_concept_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM coded o WHERE o.fk_action_unit_id IS NULL AND o.fk_value_concept_id IS NULL AND o.fk_institution_id = c.fk_institution_id AND o.field_code = c.field_code AND o.config_id < c.config_id) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.field_form_config x WHERE x.fk_form_config_id = c.config_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.form_config_group x WHERE x.fk_form_config_id = c.config_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.concept_field_state x WHERE x.fk_form_config_id = c.config_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.form_config_answer x WHERE x.fk_form_config_id = c.config_id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.identifier_counter x WHERE x.fk_form_config_id = c.config_id)))

changeSet.author: gregory bliault
changeSet.sql: UPDATE public.form_config fc SET configured_table = CASE cfc.field_code WHEN 'SIARU.TYPE' THEN 'UE' WHEN 'SIAS.CAT' THEN 'MOBILIER' WHEN 'SIAPHASE.TYPE' THEN 'PHASE' WHEN 'SIAC.TYPE' THEN 'CONTENANT' WHEN 'SIAD.TYPE' THEN 'DOCUMENT' WHEN 'SIAST.TYPE' THEN 'STUDY' WHEN 'SIAAU.TYPE' THEN 'PROJECT' END FROM public.concept_field_config cfc WHERE cfc.fk_concept_id = fc.fk_field_concept_id AND cfc.field_code IN ('SIARU.TYPE', 'SIAS.CAT', 'SIAPHASE.TYPE', 'SIAC.TYPE', 'SIAD.TYPE', 'SIAST.TYPE', 'SIAAU.TYPE');

changeSet.author: gregory bliault
changeSet.sql: UPDATE public.form_config_aud fc SET configured_table = CASE cfc.field_code WHEN 'SIARU.TYPE' THEN 'UE' WHEN 'SIAS.CAT' THEN 'MOBILIER' WHEN 'SIAPHASE.TYPE' THEN 'PHASE' WHEN 'SIAC.TYPE' THEN 'CONTENANT' WHEN 'SIAD.TYPE' THEN 'DOCUMENT' WHEN 'SIAST.TYPE' THEN 'STUDY' WHEN 'SIAAU.TYPE' THEN 'PROJECT' END FROM public.concept_field_config cfc WHERE cfc.fk_concept_id = fc.fk_field_concept_id AND cfc.field_code IN ('SIARU.TYPE', 'SIAS.CAT', 'SIAPHASE.TYPE', 'SIAC.TYPE', 'SIAD.TYPE', 'SIAST.TYPE', 'SIAAU.TYPE');

changeSet.author: gregory bliault
changeSet.sql: WITH duplicate AS ( SELECT fc.config_id, min(fc.config_id) OVER (PARTITION BY fc.fk_institution_id, fc.configured_table) AS kept_id FROM public.form_config fc WHERE fc.fk_action_unit_id IS NULL AND fc.fk_value_concept_id IS NULL ), highest AS ( SELECT d.kept_id, c.fk_institution_id, c.canonical_key, max(c.counter) AS counter FROM duplicate d JOIN public.institution_identifier_counter c ON c.fk_form_config_id = d.config_id WHERE d.config_id <> d.kept_id GROUP BY d.kept_id, c.fk_institution_id, c.canonical_key ) UPDATE public.institution_identifier_counter k SET counter = greatest(k.counter, h.counter) FROM highest h WHERE k.fk_form_config_id = h.kept_id AND k.fk_institution_id = h.fk_institution_id AND k.canonical_key = h.canonical_key;

changeSet.author: gregory bliault
changeSet.sql: WITH duplicate AS ( SELECT fc.config_id, min(fc.config_id) OVER (PARTITION BY fc.fk_institution_id, fc.configured_table) AS kept_id FROM public.form_config fc WHERE fc.fk_action_unit_id IS NULL AND fc.fk_value_concept_id IS NULL ) DELETE FROM public.institution_identifier_counter c USING duplicate d WHERE c.fk_form_config_id = d.config_id AND d.config_id <> d.kept_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.institution_identifier_counter k WHERE k.fk_form_config_id = d.kept_id AND k.fk_institution_id = c.fk_institution_id AND k.canonical_key = c.canonical_key);

changeSet.author: gregory bliault
changeSet.sql: WITH duplicate AS ( SELECT fc.config_id, min(fc.config_id) OVER (PARTITION BY fc.fk_institution_id, fc.configured_table) AS kept_id FROM public.form_config fc WHERE fc.fk_action_unit_id IS NULL AND fc.fk_value_concept_id IS NULL ) UPDATE public.institution_identifier_counter c SET fk_form_config_id = d.kept_id FROM duplicate d WHERE c.fk_form_config_id = d.config_id AND d.config_id <> d.kept_id;

changeSet.author: gregory bliault
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM public.form_config fc WHERE fc.fk_action_unit_id IS NULL AND fc.fk_value_concept_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.form_config o WHERE o.fk_action_unit_id IS NULL AND o.fk_value_concept_id IS NULL AND o.fk_institution_id = fc.fk_institution_id AND o.configured_table = fc.configured_table AND o.config_id < fc.config_id);
